CLIP (with atom IDs): E12.005 | 00:09.00-00:14.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E12.006 | 00:09.40-00:12.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (O.S., cold, venomous) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E12.007 | 00:14.00-00:20.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E12.008 | 00:14.40-00:17.82 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, shrill) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
E12.009 | 00:20.00-00:24.00 | CAM | Close-up on the Mayor's hands gripping the rail.
E12.010 | 00:24.00-00:28.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E12.011 | 00:24.20-00:28.00 | ACT | Tobin draws a short blade from a boot.
E12.012 | 00:28.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Close-up on Corin's hands gripping the rail.
E12.013 | 00:28.40-00:30.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (O.S., pompous, cold) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
E12.014 | 00:34.00-00:38.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Tobin and Corin, the space between them charged.
E12.015 | 00:34.40-00:37.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E12.016 | 00:38.00-00:44.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on the Mayor's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E12.017 | 00:44.00-00:47.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's jaw tightening.
E12.018 | 00:44.40-00:46.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, nervous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
